anomalies.observed: The MAX3485 receiver output RO (U2 pin 1) is labelled NET0361, while the M-BUS pin 16 (RXD2, shown on the J3 header's right column) is labelled NET0036. Nothing on the sheet joins these two net names, so RO appears not to reach the PortC RXD2 pin.
anomalies.expected: Per the spec, U1 (MAX3485) converts the PortC UART (TXD2/RXD2, J1/J2 pins 15/16) to the servo bus, so its RO output should feed RXD2 (pin 16) on the same net.

evidence.quote: U2 MAX3485 pin 1 (RO) wired to label "NET0361"; J3 pin 16 labelled "NET0036" (sheet 1/1, root sheet)
Serial mode ... driven by U1 (MAX3485), fed from the M5Stack's PortC UART (`/TXD2`/`/RXD2`, J1/J2 pins 15/16)

anomalies.impact: The receive path from the servo bus to the Core is broken, so serial servo replies (angle read-back, ID responses) would never reach the MCU, undermining the serial-mode feature.

parsed.summary: The schematic is mostly consistent with the spec's serial/PWM architecture and bias values, but the MAX3485 RO output sits on a different net (NET0361) from the RXD2 bus pin (NET0036), suggesting a broken receive path; this is only moderately certain given the drawing's reference designators differ from the spec.
